hookups.source: https://woodwardcave.com/camping/ ('RV spots with full water and electric', 'Sites with Electric and Water') + the operator's booking engine https://parkwith.us/camps/woodward-cave-and-campground (bookable RV sites B and I list 20/30/50-amp, the others 20/30 or 20, all with water), read 2026-10-20

values.note: The operator says 'over 50 RV sites with water and electric' plus private and group tent areas and cabins. On its booking engine only 8 RV sites (A-G, I) are bookable by the night, all back-in, max length 40-45 ft (site I 60 ft); the other ~50 RV sites are seasonal.

sites.source: https://woodwardcave.com/ ('We have over 50 RV sites with water and electric') + https://parkwith.us/camps/woodward-cave-and-campground (per-site kind 'back-in', max_length, camping style rv vs seasonal), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://woodwardcave.com/camping/ ('Fully Stocked Camp Store', 'Bathrooms and Hot Showers', 'Dumping Station') + https://parkwith.us/camps/woodward-cave-and-campground (check-in policy names the campground wireless network), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Operator: 'Camping at Woodward is open from April to October'; its events list gives 'Apr 19 - Start of Camping Season' and 'Oct 19 - Last Day of Camping Season'; the booking engine's season runs 04-17 to 10-19. Exact dates move a little each year.

Booked online through the Park With Us engine linked from the operator's site ('Reserve your spot with easy online booking'); one-night stays allowed on RV sites (2-night minimum applies to the cabin only), same-day reservations allowed, bookings for the year open January 1. Full refund minus processing fees with more than 3 days' notice. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://woodwardcave.com/camping/ + https://parkwith.us/camps/woodward-cave-and-campground (camping style rv: minimum_bookable_nights 1, allow_same_day_reservations, booking_start 01-01, refund policy, check-in/out times), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed 50-amp electric and water, reservable online (Park With Us engine), open mid-April to October 19. Added showers, dump, camp store, wifi; 8 nightly back-in RV sites to 40-60 ft (rest of the ~50 RV sites seasonal). Fees left as recorded: the operator's pages no longer post a rate and the booking engine's quote API returned prorated monthly figures ($23-30) rather than a nightly price, so nothing new to write. Sewer not stated.
flags: Rates no longer visible on woodwardcave.com (the AWH-read 30A $35 / 50A $50 2026 figures are not on any page now); the Park With Us price API answers only prorated monthly-rate figures. A human could get a live nightly quote in the booking engine for a 2027 date.
Mostly seasonal park: the booking engine lists 8 nightly RV sites against ~51 seasonal ones (about 1 in 7 sold by the night, so it passes the 1-in-10 test but not by much).
